capabilities: browse and search vault Markdown, HTML, and image files across nested folders
select passages in sources to save source-linked excerpts without editing the original
insert reflection prompts (My understanding, Connections, Try it out) into notes
hide excerpts and explain them from memory, then check against the source
quick-capture notes with formatting, tags, and image attachments
extras: Default interface language is Simplified Chinese with an English setting; manual installation is described; the listing notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff; no network requests or telemetry; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ with desktop as the primary tested target.
problem: Obsidian has no single place to move from collecting passages to writing your own interpretations, connections, and next steps.
summary: Reading dashboard that lets you browse vault files, excerpt source passages with links, and write your own explanations in plain Markdown.
